desktop.title: Security
desktop.metaDescription: Vanta is "security in a box" for technology companies — we build a suite of simple, effective, and easy-to-deploy tools powerful enough to take a company through full SOC 2 compliance.
h2: Vanta’s Security and Privacy teams establish policies and controls, monitor compliance with those controls, and prove our security and compliance to third-party auditors.
